in_sanskrit.name: Kshirod
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kshirod एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kshirod is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kshira', which means 'nectar' or 'milk' and 'Rodh', which means 'manifestation' or 'appearance'. In Hindu mythology, Kshirod is considered to be the lord of the universe, the embodiment of love, compassion, and wisdom. He is also known as the god of grace, beauty, and happiness.
